thread:
Priya M: I'm landing a refresh for the Ignite quickstart that updates auth to SDK v2 and renames the env var to REDWOOD_KEY (previously REDWOOD_API_KEY). Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478. Need one reviewer on code samples and someone to sanity-check the CI smoke test.

Diego R: I'll review the JS + python snippets. Can you paste them here so I can scan for idiomatic usage?

Priya M: Node snippet: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
try {
  const out = await client.generate({ model: 'rw-open-7b', input: 'Hi Ignite' })
  console.log(out.text)
} catch (err) {
  console.error('generate failed', err)
}
```
Python snippet: 
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(model='rw-open-7b', input='Hi from Ignite')
print(resp['text'])
```

Nora L: Looks good. Two suggestions: 1) include a cURL example for non-SDK users; 2) add a short "migration note" at the top of the quickstart calling out the env var change and vault guidance for Dedicated/Private.

Priya M: cURL example: 
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-7b","input":"Hello from curl"}'
```

docs-bot: link-checker: Found one stale link in docs/quickstarts/ignite.md -> https://old.docs.example/ignite (replace with https://docs.redwood.ai/ignite or remove).

Kai S: I'll patch the link and add the migration notice. Also will include a short note under "Deployment" recommending KMS/vault for REDWOOD_KEY on Dedicated/Private installs.

Priya M: Thanks @Kai. Also CI flagged the smoke test: ci-bot reports the quickstart smoke job flaked with "EADDRINUSE: address already in use" on port 8080. CI log: https://ci.internal.redwood/ignite/99/logs

ci-bot: quickstart-smoke #99 failed at step 'start-sample' - error: port 8080 busy. Suggest random port allocation OR pre-kill processes bound to PORT.

Diego R: For reproducibility let's make the test pick an available port via node's get-port (or pass PORT=0). If using `PORT=0` some frameworks print chosen port; but the test harness needs to read it. Alternately pick a free ephemeral port before launching.

Priya M: Good plan. I'll update the CI step to use `npx get-port` in the job and export PORT. Will also modify the sample to respect PORT from env.

Nora L: One more UX ask: add a tiny screenshot of the running sample UI and a Console route screenshot (token usage view). I can capture those and upload; can you add a note on image size limits? We prefer 900px max width and under 250KB.

Priya M: Noted. @Nora please upload to the PR as attachments. @Diego once you finish snippet review and Kai lands the link/migration edits I'll re-run CI. Hoping to merge today.

Kai S: Pushed link fix, migration blurb, and vault callout. PR link updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478/files

Diego R: Inline comments posted about catching errors and a tiny wording tweak in the python sample. LGTM otherwise.

Priya M: CI passed on #101. Merging to main and will add a changelog entry for the quickstart refresh. Thanks all! :shipit:

Priya M: Good catch, adding that next.
